pr_title: promql: Fix various UTF-8 bugs related to quoting
pr_body:
Fixes UTF-8 aggregator label list items getting mutated with quote marks when String-ified.
Fixes quoted metric names not supported in metric declarations.
Fixes UTF-8 label names not being quoted when String-ified.

Fixes https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/15470
Fixes https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/15528
pr_comments: any ideas why my TestParseSeriesDesc test is failing on CI but not on my machine? I have Go 1.23.3 locally
ok I can get it to fail with --tags=dedupelabels
ok it's probably because label equality is not the right way to test

> Why does the parser change?

the parser change is the second item -- quoted metric names were not supported in the "series description" path, which is separate from the vector selector path that had been updated.

issue_context.title: Add UTF-8 support to testing framework and add UTF-8 tests
issue_context.body: Right now the promqltest framework does not turn on nor test utf-8. Implementing this will be a good step towards fixing https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/15470

review_comments: What is this testing?  Why don't we need the previous test case any more?

this test was relying on an error being thrown because the label name was invalid.  Under UTF-8 the old name is now valid, so the test was failing. Adding a bad unicode value causes it to once again throw an error.
